display.purpose: Hero titles and Kana specimens in Literata serif.

body.purpose: Multilingual learning text in Inter sans.

motion.name: ease-zen
motion.purpose: Smooth organic easing for transitions and flips.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with soft rounded corners and subtle shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #38656f; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0px 4px 12px rgba(56, 101, 111, 0.2); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4d56; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0px 6px 16px rgba(56, 101, 111, 0.3); }

components.name: Zen Card
components.description: Organic rounded container with diffused elevation.
components.css: .ds-zen-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0px 4px 20px rgba(45, 52, 70, 0.05); border: 1px solid #c0c8ca; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; transition: all 0.25s ease; } .ds-zen-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0px 12px 32px rgba(45, 52, 70, 0.09); }

narrative.overview: Zen Kana blends the calm, disciplined balance of Japanese traditional aesthetics with the clarity of modern educational tools. The interface evokes a serene Kyoto study atmosphere in light mode—using soft slate teals, rosewood accents, and porcelain-tinted surfaces—and transitions into an immersive Midnight Navy and Mint Teal sanctuary in dark mode.
keyCharacteristics: Organic, softly rounded cards (rounded-zen / 16px radius) paired with gentle diffused elevation.
Dual-font typography: Literata for elegant, authoritative Japanese Kana display and hero headlines; Inter for crisp, effortless multilingual reading.
Tactile, friendly micro-interactions with smooth 3D card flips and active scale presses.

rules.name: The Sanctuary Balance Rule
rules.body: Color accents never overpower content. Surfaces remain neutral and expansive; teal and mint are reserved for actionable targets and meaningful feedback.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Cards lift subtly on hover (translateY(-2px) or scale(1.015)) with an accompanying shadow diffusion, creating an organic tactile feel.

dos: Do maintain rounded radii (rounded-xl to rounded-2xl) for a soft, welcoming feel.
Do use Literata for Japanese glyphs to preserve traditional stroke aesthetics.
Do keep animations smooth, peaceful, and easing-based (cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)).
donts: Don't use harsh zero-radius boxy corners.
Don't flood screens with saturated neon backgrounds.
Don't use pure #000000 pitch black backgrounds in dark mode; use Midnight Navy #0b0f19.
